shots.scene: 欣欣端着一个垫好吸水纸的托盘，旁边一只带标志的废物桶
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a tray lined with absorbent paper, next to a waste bin with a radiation warning sign.
shots.narration: 这一课讲非密封源操作与放射性废物。
overlay: 非密封源操作与放射性废物

shots.scene: 阿杰做完同位素标记实验，戴着手套伸手去拿水杯
shots.prompt_en: The young male student finishes a labelling experiment and, still wearing gloves, reaches for his water bottle on the bench.
shots.narration: 阿杰做完标记实验，戴着手套想喝水。

shots.scene: 阿杰把用过的手套扔进普通垃圾桶
shots.prompt_en: The young male student tosses used gloves into an ordinary trash can.
shots.narration: 用过的手套，他顺手扔进了普通垃圾桶。

shots.scene: 小研抬手拦住，水杯和普通垃圾桶上各一个红叉
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student raises a hand to stop him; a red cross appears over the water bottle and over the ordinary trash can.
shots.narration: 小研赶紧拦住：两件事都错了！

shots.section_title: 放射性物质怎样进入体内
shots.scene: 一瓶开盖的放射性溶液，液滴溅出、蒸气上升、手套沾上斑点
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an open vial of radioactive liquid with small droplets splashing, a faint vapor rising and spots on a glove. No text.
shots.narration: 非密封源会洒、会挥发，还会沾污。
overlay: 放射性物质怎样进入体内

shots.section_title: 放射性物质怎样进入体内
shots.scene: 人体轮廓，鼻、口、手上伤口、皮肤四个箭头指向体内
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a body outline with four arrows entering through the nose, the mouth, a cut on the hand and the skin. No text.
shots.narration: 吸入、食入、伤口和皮肤，都能进体内。

shots.section_title: 放射性物质怎样进入体内
shots.scene: 体内器官里亮着一个小点，持续发出射线
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a small glowing dot lodged inside an organ, sending out rays continuously. No text.
shots.narration: 一进体内就是内照射，躲不开也挡不住。

shots.section_title: 放射性物质怎样进入体内
shots.scene: 一张纸挡住α粒子；同样的粒子在体内器官里造成损伤
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a sheet of paper stopping alpha particles, then the same particles damaging an organ from inside. No text.
shots.narration: α体外一张纸能挡，进了体内危害大。

shots.section_title: 放射性物质怎样进入体内
shots.scene: 盾牌挡住鼻子、嘴和手上的伤口
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a shield icon covering the nose, the mouth and a cut on the hand. No text.
shots.narration: 所以操作非密封源，重在防止摄入。

shots.scene: 平面图上一块划出边界的工作区，门口有批准文件图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a floor plan with one marked work zone and an approval document icon at its door. No text.
shots.narration: 非密封源只在批准的指定区域操作。

shots.scene: 光滑无缝的台面和地面，液滴一擦就干净
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a smooth seamless bench top and floor, a droplet wiped away cleanly. No text.
shots.narration: 台面地面不渗透、易去污。

shots.scene: 专用通风柜和手套箱并排，气流向内
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a dedicated fume hood and a glove box side by side, with airflow arrows going inward. No text.
shots.narration: 放射性操作用专用通风柜或手套箱。

shots.scene: 挥发性液体和粉末图标被放进通风柜
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: icons of a volatile liquid and a powder being placed inside the fume hood. No text.
shots.narration: 易挥发、粉末操作，必须进柜。

shots.scene: 工作区边界贴着电离辐射警告标志，台面上只放必需物品
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an ionizing radiation warning sign on the work zone boundary, the bench holding only the needed items. No text.
shots.narration: 区域边界有标志，无关物品不放。

shots.section_title: 托盘、吸水纸与个人防护
shots.scene: 【实拍】托盘里铺吸水纸，吸水面朝上、防水面朝下的手部特写（空托盘，不用放射性物质）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: hands lining a tray with absorbent bench paper, absorbent side up and plastic side down.
shots.narration: 托盘里垫吸水纸，吸水面朝上。
overlay: 托盘、吸水纸与个人防护

shots.section_title: 托盘、吸水纸与个人防护
shots.scene: 一滴液体落在托盘里被吸水纸吸住，托盘外台面干净
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a droplet falling into the tray and soaked up by the paper, the bench outside the tray staying clean. No text.
shots.narration: 洒了也只在托盘里，好收拾。

shots.section_title: 托盘、吸水纸与个人防护
shots.scene: 【实拍】穿实验服、戴护目镜和一次性手套的顺序示范（不在辐射工作场所拍）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a person putting on a lab coat, safety goggles and disposable gloves in order.
shots.narration: 穿实验服，戴手套和护目镜。

shots.section_title: 托盘、吸水纸与个人防护
shots.scene: 双层手套和鞋套图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: icons of double gloves and shoe covers. No text.
shots.narration: 需要时戴双层手套，穿鞋套。

shots.section_title: 托盘、吸水纸与个人防护
shots.scene: 课堂演示：老师在托盘里操作，学生站在警戒线外，做完把容器放回屏蔽罐
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a classroom demonstration with the work done in a tray, students standing behind a barrier line, the vial returned to a shielded pot. No text.
shots.narration: 演示实验也要防护，做完收回清点。

shots.scene: 工作区里食物、水杯、香烟、口红四个图标都打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: food, a cup, a cigarette and a lipstick icon inside the work zone, each crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 工作区不吃不喝、不吸烟、不化妆。

shots.scene: 饮料瓶不能放进实验室冰箱，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a drink bottle being put into a lab fridge, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 食品饮料不带进来，不放实验冰箱。

shots.scene: 嘴对着移液管打叉；旁边移液器打钩
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a mouth on a pipette crossed out, and a pipette filler with a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 绝不用嘴吸移液管，用移液器。

shots.scene: 戴手套的手伸向脸、眼睛和手机，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a gloved hand reaching for the face, the eyes and a phone, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 戴着手套，别摸脸揉眼、别碰手机。

shots.scene: 手上贴着创可贴，开放源图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand with a bandaged cut, and an open source icon crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 手上有伤口，不操作开放源。

shots.section_title: 操作后自检与擦拭监测
shots.scene: 检查清单：手、衣服、鞋、台面四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a checklist with four icons, hands, clothes, shoes and the bench top. No text.
shots.narration: 做完先测：手、衣服、鞋和台面。
overlay: 操作后自检与擦拭监测

shots.section_title: 操作后自检与擦拭监测
shots.scene: 【实拍】表面污染仪探头贴近手掌慢慢移动的手法特写（仪器不对放射源，只示范手法）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a contamination meter probe moved slowly just above a palm without touching it.
shots.narration: 探头贴近慢慢扫，别碰到表面。

shots.section_title: 操作后自检与擦拭监测
shots.scene: 摘手套、洗手、再测，三步箭头
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three steps with arrows, removing gloves, washing hands, measuring again. No text.
shots.narration: 摘手套、洗手，再测一次才离开。

shots.section_title: 操作后自检与擦拭监测
shots.scene: 【实拍】用滤纸擦拭台面固定面积取样的手法特写（空白台面，不用放射性物质）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a gloved hand wiping a marked patch of bench with a filter paper disc.
shots.narration: 擦拭取样，能查出看不见的污染。

shots.section_title: 操作后自检与擦拭监测
shots.scene: 日历上定期的擦拭和巡测记录，存进文件夹
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a calendar with regular wipe and survey records being filed into a folder. No text.
shots.narration: 定期擦拭和巡测，结果记录在案。

shots.section_title: 发现污染：围住、报告、去污、复测
shots.scene: 仪器读数升高，人停下双手
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a meter needle rising and a worker stopping with both hands raised. No text.
shots.narration: 测到污染，先停下，别扩散。
overlay: 发现污染：围住、报告、去污、复测

shots.section_title: 发现污染：围住、报告、去污、复测
shots.scene: 污染处用吸水纸盖住，四周围起警戒线
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the contaminated spot covered with absorbent paper and a barrier line around it. No text.
shots.narration: 盖住并标出范围，别让人踩过。

shots.section_title: 发现污染：围住、报告、去污、复测
shots.scene: 小研打电话给老周和王老师
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student phones the older man and the safety administrator.
shots.narration: 报告实验室负责人和辐射安全管理员。

shots.section_title: 发现污染：围住、报告、去污、复测
shots.scene: 从外圈向中心擦拭的箭头，擦过的纸进放射性废物袋
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: wiping arrows from the outer edge toward the center, used paper going into a radioactive waste bag. No text.
shots.narration: 由外向内去污，废物进放射性袋。

shots.section_title: 发现污染：围住、报告、去污、复测
shots.scene: 手在温水下用肥皂轻轻洗；硬毛刷打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: hands gently washed with mild soap under lukewarm water; a stiff scrub brush crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 皮肤沾污温水肥皂轻洗，别用力刷。

shots.section_title: 发现污染：围住、报告、去污、复测
shots.scene: 复测打钩；大面积洒漏图标指向应急预案
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a re-check with a check mark, and a large spill icon pointing to an emergency plan folder. No text.
shots.narration: 去污后复测，大面积洒漏按应急处置。

shots.section_title: 天然放射性物质也要管
shots.scene: 含铀试剂瓶和一块矿石，旁边小小的射线符号
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a reagent bottle and a mineral rock, each with a small radiation trefoil. No text.
shots.narration: 含铀、含钍的试剂和矿石，也有放射性。
overlay: 天然放射性物质也要管

shots.section_title: 天然放射性物质也要管
shots.scene: 专柜上锁，领用登记本
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a locked cabinet and a sign out logbook. No text.
shots.narration: 专柜存放，登记领用和归还。

shots.section_title: 天然放射性物质也要管
shots.scene: 这类废弃物进放射性废物桶，下水道打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: such waste going into a radioactive waste bin, a sink drain crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 废弃物按放射性废物处理，不倒下水道。

shots.section_title: 天然放射性物质也要管
shots.scene: 地下实验室，排风扇转动
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a basement lab with an exhaust fan turning. No text.
shots.narration: 地下实验室，要关注通风和氡。

shots.scene: 实验台到废物桶的箭头
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an arrow from a lab bench to a waste bin. No text.
shots.narration: 用了放射性，就一定会有废物。

shots.scene: 只领需要的小量，多余的打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: taking only a small needed amount, the extra amount crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 按需领用，够用就好。

shots.scene: 托盘里操作，沾污的物品很少
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: work done in a tray, with only a few contaminated items. No text.
shots.narration: 在托盘里操作，少沾污就少废物。

shots.scene: 干净的包装纸被塞进放射性桶，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: clean wrapping paper being stuffed into a radioactive waste bin, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 没沾污的东西，别往放射性桶里塞。

shots.scene: 带辐射标志的专用桶，和普通垃圾桶分开
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a dedicated bin with a radiation warning sign standing apart from an ordinary trash can. No text.
shots.narration: 放射性废物单独收集，进专用容器。

shots.scene: 放射性废物不能混进普通、化学和医疗废物桶
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a radioactive waste item kept away from ordinary, chemical and medical waste bins, crossed arrows. No text.
shots.narration: 不混进普通垃圾、化学和医疗废物。

shots.scene: 废液倒向水槽，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: liquid waste being poured into a sink, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 放射性废液，绝不倒进下水道。

shots.scene: 三个分开的容器：固体袋、液体瓶、锐器盒
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three separate containers, a solid waste bag, a liquid waste bottle and a sharps box. No text.
shots.narration: 固体、液体、锐器，分开收集。

shots.scene: 两个桶：短半衰期和长半衰期分开
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two bins side by side, one for short half life and one for long half life, with clock icons. No text.
shots.narration: 不同核素、长短半衰期也分开。

shots.scene: 放射性物品不出场所门，旁边是校园和河流
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a radioactive item stopped at the work area door, with a campus and a river outside. No text.
shots.narration: 放射性物品不带出场所，保护公众环境。

shots.scene: 【实拍】带电离辐射警告标志、脚踏开盖的专用废物桶外观特写（空桶）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: an empty pedal waste bin with a lid and an ionizing radiation warning sign.
shots.narration: 专用容器有标志，盖子要盖严。

shots.scene: 【实拍】在空白废物标签上逐项填写的手部特写（不拍真实核素信息）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a hand filling in a blank waste label line by line.
shots.narration: 标签写核素、活度、日期和责任人。

shots.scene: 下一位接手的人对照标签核对
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the next person checking the label against a record sheet. No text.
shots.narration: 如实填写，后面的人才能核对。

shots.scene: 容器外表面被擦拭检查，干净打钩
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the outer surface of the container being wiped and checked, with a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 容器外表面，不能有沾污。

shots.scene: 装满的袋子封口，贴上标签
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a full bag being sealed and a label attached. No text.
shots.narration: 装满后密封，再贴规定的标签。

shots.scene: 实验小鼠体内有发光的点
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a lab mouse with small glowing dots inside its body. No text.
shots.narration: 示踪实验后，动物体内也有核素。

shots.scene: 鼠笼里的垫料和排泄物带射线符号
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: cage bedding and droppings marked with a small radiation trefoil. No text.
shots.narration: 排泄物和垫料，也带放射性。

shots.scene: 垫料收进专用袋，贴标签
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the bedding collected into a dedicated bag with a label. No text.
shots.narration: 收进专用袋，标明核素和日期。

shots.scene: 动物尸体放进带标志的专用冷柜，普通尸体柜打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an animal carcass going into a dedicated freezer with a warning sign, an ordinary carcass freezer crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 尸体进专柜暂存，登记后按规定处理。

shots.scene: 老李推着推车上门收集废物
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer pushes a cart to the lab door to collect waste.
shots.narration: 专人上门收集，送到暂存间。

shots.scene: 老李打开清单检查评估废物
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer checks the waste against a list before packing it into a dedicated container.
shots.narration: 先检查评估，看清是什么废物。

shots.scene: 仪器测量桶，旁边标签和记录对照
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a meter measuring a waste drum, compared with its label and a record. No text.
shots.narration: 用仪器再测，核对标签上的活度。

shots.scene: 老李戴手套用推车搬运，抱在怀里打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the facility engineer wearing gloves moving a drum on a cart; carrying it hugged to the chest crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 穿戴防护用推车，别抱在怀里。

shots.scene: 搬运完检测手和鞋
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: checking hands and shoes with a meter after moving waste. No text.
shots.narration: 搬完测一测手和鞋。

shots.section_title: 暂存间：专用、上锁、有台账
shots.scene: 暂存间门上锁，贴着电离辐射警告标志
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a locked storage room door with an ionizing radiation warning sign. No text.
shots.narration: 暂存间专用、上锁、有标志。
overlay: 暂存间：专用、上锁、有台账

shots.section_title: 暂存间：专用、上锁、有台账
shots.scene: 进出登记本和清点表，账和物一一对上
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an entry logbook and an inventory sheet, each record matched to a drum. No text.
shots.narration: 进出登记，定期清点，账物相符。

shots.section_title: 暂存间：专用、上锁、有台账
shots.scene: 桶周围加了屏蔽墙，无关人员被拦在门外
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: shielding blocks around the drums and an unauthorized person stopped at the door. No text.
shots.narration: 必要时加屏蔽，无关人员不得进入。

shots.section_title: 暂存间：专用、上锁、有台账
shots.scene: 安全和安保两个盾牌
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two shields, one for safety and one for security. No text.
shots.narration: 暂存期间，安全和安保永远第一。

shots.section_title: 暂存间：专用、上锁、有台账
shots.scene: 教学楼里堆满桶，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a teaching building with corridors piled with drums, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 教学楼不是长期仓库，不能久存。

shots.scene: 桶旁边的时钟，桶上的射线符号逐渐变淡
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a clock beside a drum, the radiation trefoil on the drum slowly fading. No text.
shots.narration: 短半衰期废物，可以存放等它衰变。

shots.scene: 快转的小钟和慢转的大钟
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a small fast running clock and a large slow running clock. No text.
shots.narration: 半衰期短衰变快，半衰期长存得久。

shots.scene: 到期监测，审批印章，打钩
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: measuring the drum when the time is up, an approval stamp and a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 到期监测达标、经批准，才能解控。

shots.scene: 记录归档，标准书上打钩
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: records filed in a binder and a standards book with a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 全程记录；时间和标准以现行规定为准。

shots.section_title: 长寿命废物交有资质单位收贮
shots.scene: 封好的桶装上专用车，送往有资质的收贮单位
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: sealed drums loaded onto a dedicated vehicle heading to a licensed waste storage facility. No text.
shots.narration: 其余废物交有资质的单位收贮。
overlay: 长寿命废物交有资质单位收贮

shots.section_title: 长寿命废物交有资质单位收贮
shots.scene: 医院、科研楼、大学都指向同一个问题标记
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hospital, a research building and a university all pointing to the same question mark. No text.
shots.narration: 医学和科研单位，都会遇到废物问题。

shots.section_title: 长寿命废物交有资质单位收贮
shots.scene: 集中设施四周有围墙和监控
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a central storage facility with walls and cameras around it. No text.
shots.narration: 集中到专门设施，安全安保更稳妥。

shots.section_title: 长寿命废物交有资质单位收贮
shots.scene: 一个桶剖开：里面是干燥固体，层层包装
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cutaway drum showing dry solid items inside several layers of packaging. No text.
shots.narration: 多是干燥固体，层层包装，不必恐慌。

shots.scene: 鼻、口、伤口被盾牌挡住，托盘和吸水纸
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a shield over the nose, mouth and a cut, next to a tray with absorbent paper. No text.
shots.narration: 防摄入：托盘吸水纸，不吃不喝不吸。

shots.scene: 仪器测手，污染处围起
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a meter checking hands, and a contaminated spot fenced off. No text.
shots.narration: 做完必测；有污染，围住报告再去污。

shots.scene: 分开的废物桶、标签、暂存间和时钟
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: separate waste bins, a label, a locked storage room and a clock. No text.
shots.narration: 废物分类贴标，衰变暂存或送贮。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着一台巡测仪和一个剂量计挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a survey meter and a dosimeter badge and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课：辐射监测仪器。
